exposure: fertility-sparing management for uterine smooth muscle tumours of uncertain malignant potential (STUMP)
cohort: 106 patients with a histological diagnosis of uterine smooth muscle tumours of uncertain malignant potential (STUMP) who underwent fertility-sparing treatment.
finding: Fertility-sparing management for STUMP is feasible and safe, but pregnancy after surgery was associated with a significantly higher rate of uterine disease recurrence.
